work.title: Two Faces, Snowman Field
work.description: A pale street wall with two stenciled faces in black and blue spray, one with a red ball-eye, the other in profile. A scatter of small Mr. Snowmann figures fills the lower register, alongside a black radial-rayed skull motif. Loose, sketched, character-driven.
work.composition: stencil cluster on wall, snowman scatter base
